note: Owner and deadline are the two fields a person sets. They live in the workbook above and are read into the build through the Microsoft 365 connector. Status, counts and closure are NEVER read from it - they are computed from data/action_conditions.json every build. If this file is missing or stale the page falls back to the values written in the body rows and says so.

sources.note: Where each answer that closes or annotates an action came from: sender, date, subject, one-line answer. Rendered into the action's collapsed detail by tools/render_actions.py. Not part of the workbook: owner and deadline stay in 'owners'.

act-confirm-maroantsetra-fnrb-value.subject: Re: Water program dashboard & actions
act-confirm-maroantsetra-fnrb-value.answer: Maroantsetra fNRB is 36%, not 34%, in line with the sub-national value applied for Fort-Dauphin; James corrects it at verification.

act-confirm-whether-ersdws-v2.subject: Re: Water program dashboard & actions
act-confirm-whether-ersdws-v2.answer: v2.0 applies from 1 January 2026 with some grandfathering; alignment at the verification submission (Q1 2027), full alignment at the crediting-period renewal; v2.0 to be tried for 2025 through the design-change pathway.

act-v2-sample-size.subject: Re: Water program dashboard & actions
act-v2-sample-size.answer: 50 per stratum for sampling, to be safe.

act-sdws27-basis.subject: Re: Water program dashboard & actions
act-sdws27-basis.answer: Capped at 347 days without a sensor; actual days claimable only for sensor-fitted pumps, sampled 50 per stratum, with the cap on the rest; a lost or damaged calendar is acceptable given the SOP, visits and call log. James Walker's ruling, not Gold Standard's.

act-settle-baseline-boiling-device.subject: Re: Water program dashboard & actions
act-settle-baseline-boiling-device.answer: The ex post figures are adjusted by the share of end users reporting an improved cookstove in the annual monitoring; Fort-Dauphin 2025: 81%.

act-reconcile-cookstove-water-programmes.subject: Re: Water program dashboard & actions
act-reconcile-cookstove-water-programmes.answer: The methodology provides for cookstove and safe-water cross-effects; the stacking prohibition applies to Impact Statements only, not to credits.

act-put-current-methodology-vpa.subject: instruction for the water report
act-put-current-methodology-vpa.answer: The VPA-DD is filed in Water Documents/Methodology of record with its SHA-256, beside ERSDWS v1.0 and v2.0; the registered original on Carbon2 governs.

act-update-sops-portfolio-figures.subject: instruction for the water report
act-update-sops-portfolio-figures.answer: Stroke-test SOP v2.1 carries the current portfolio figures (652 Canzee + 80 India Mark III = 732) from the weekly report.

act-resolve-sdws-27-sdws.subject: Re: Water program dashboard & actions
act-resolve-sdws-27-sdws.answer: Numbering settled: SDWS 28 is the published ID, 27 was the consultation version.

act-resolve-sdws-27-sdws.subject: Re: Water program dashboard & actions
act-resolve-sdws-27-sdws.answer: Gold Standard published the wrong version and were supposed to remove the part about validating the stroke test with another method.

act-resolve-sdws-27-sdws.subject: Re: Water program dashboard & actions
act-resolve-sdws-27-sdws.answer: The stroke-test validation requirement is expected to be removed; not confirmed until later this year.

act-indiamark-premises.subject: RE: Water program dashboard & actions (draft)
act-indiamark-premises.answer: Question drafted to James: apply 500 people per India Mark now on Carter's 200-500 range, or hold 300 until StrokeMeter volumes. Draft, not yet sent.

act-v2-embodied.subject: Re: Water program dashboard & actions
act-v2-embodied.answer: Embodied emissions will be accounted for at the verification.

act-update-parameters-workbook-cite.subject: Re: Water program dashboard & actions
act-update-parameters-workbook-cite.answer: Tool30 is dead, so James will correct that on the hub.

act-transcription-round.answer: Machine reading is fine; James wants a few verified, a spot check.

act-sensor-sample.subject: Re: Water program dashboard & actions
act-sensor-sample.answer: Sensors on a sample of 50 per stratum, to be safe; the actual days claimable for those 100, the cap on the rest.

act-verification-fnrb-correction.subject: Re: Water program dashboard & actions
act-verification-fnrb-correction.answer: James will update the Maroantsetra fNRB in the verification as a correction.

act-design-change-q1-2027.subject: Re: Water program dashboard & actions

act-piped-fnrb.subject: Re: Water program dashboard & actions
act-piped-fnrb.answer: For the piped VPA, apply the national figure (36%) rather than taking the hit on Tana (26%); Moramanga is 37%.
